hero.headline: Comprehensive Gold Trading Services
hero.subheadline: From bulk bullion supply to purity testing and investment advisory — everything a jeweller or investor needs under one roof.

services.title: Bullion Trading
services.tagline: Buy and sell at live market rates with full transparency.
services.description: We offer competitive bullion trading for jewellers, retailers, and institutional buyers. All transactions are documented, priced at live MCX/IBJA rates, and settled promptly. Whether you need 10 grams or 10 kilograms, our trading desk is available six days a week.

services.title: Gold Bars & Coins
services.tagline: Premium 24K and 22K certified gold in multiple denominations.
services.description: We stock BIS hallmarked gold bars and coins in denominations from 1g to 1kg. All products carry assay certification and are sourced from LBMA-accredited refineries. Ideal for gifting, investment, and retail display.

features.text: Custom packaging for gifting and retail

services.title: Purity Testing
services.tagline: Certified XRF and fire assay testing for accurate gold valuation.
services.description: Our in-house laboratory uses XRF spectrometry and traditional fire assay methods to determine gold purity with precision. Trusted by jewellers across Ahmedabad for incoming gold verification, estate valuation, and dispute resolution.

services.title: Buy / Sell Gold
services.tagline: Instant buy and sell at live rates — no hidden charges.
services.description: Bring your gold — bars, coins, jewellery, or scrap — and receive an instant valuation at live market rates. We buy all forms of gold and pay immediately. No deductions, no delays, no hidden charges.

features.text: All forms accepted — bars, coins, jewellery, scrap
Immediate payment — cash or bank transfer
No hidden deductions or processing fees

services.title: Gold Loans
services.tagline: Quick gold-backed loans at competitive interest rates.
services.description: Unlock the value of your gold without selling it. Our gold loan facility offers up to 75% LTV at competitive interest rates with secure vault storage. Ideal for jewellers managing seasonal cash flow and individuals needing short-term liquidity.

services.title: Investment Schemes
services.tagline: Systematic gold accumulation for long-term wealth.
services.description: Our systematic gold accumulation plans let you invest in gold monthly at prevailing rates, averaging your cost over time. We also offer advisory on Sovereign Gold Bonds, Gold ETFs, and physical gold allocation strategies.

cta.headline: Ready to Get Started?
cta.subheadline: Contact our trading desk for bulk enquiries, purity testing appointments, or investment advisory.
